front.title: Region Division in Networks using BGP-LS SPF Routing

abstract.t: In large-scale networks using BGP-LS SPF routing, region division is necessary to make the networks stable. Some networks (e.g., satellite networks) have the characteristics of a flat design, which means that no backbone region exists in the network. This document presents a routing framework for region division in large-scale flat BGP-LS SPF routing networks. This framework can realize flexible region division, establish intra-region and inter-region paths, and complete end-to-end data forwarding.
